All 4 tests pass, and I verified `tsc --noEmit` (using a cached TypeScript 5.6.3 + `@types/node`, since this sandbox has no network access to run `npm install` itself) succeeds cleanly against the new `tsconfig.json`.

Summary of changes:
- `src/cli.ts` — `run(["--version"])` now returns `manifest().version`; usage text updated to mention `--version`.
- `src/cli.test.ts` — added a test asserting `run(["--version"])` equals the manifest version.
- `package.json` — added `typescript: 5.6.3` (exact) and `@types/node` (needed for the `node:*` imports to typecheck) as devDependencies, plus a `typecheck: tsc --noEmit` script.
- `tsconfig.json` — new file (NodeNext module/resolution, strict, `allowImportingTsExtensions` so the existing `.ts`-extension imports keep working, `noEmit`).

One caveat: this sandbox has no network access, so I couldn't run `npm install` inside the repo itself — I verified the typecheck against a TypeScript 5.6.3 install cached elsewhere on disk. You'll want to run `npm install` yourself to refresh `package-lock.json` before relying on it in CI.
